content.text: The text is an extensive alphabetical medical index covering diseases, symptoms, pathology, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, and therapeutic substances. Major topics include gastric and intestinal disorders, liver and pancreatic diseases, oesophageal and rectal conditions, rheumatism, gout, rheumatoid arthritis, syphilis, scrofula, rachitis, scurvy, diabetes, parasitic infections, peritonitis, and respiratory or pharyngeal diseases. Entries cross-reference clinical manifestations, morbid anatomy, causes, complications, historical theories, and treatments such as diet, rest, medicines, baths, enemata, cauterization, surgery, and drainage. The index particularly emphasizes gastrointestinal diseases, including gastritis, ulcers, cancer, intestinal catarrh, obstruction, hemorrhage, worms, dysentery, constipation, and pancreatic disorders, alongside detailed liver pathology such as jaundice, cirrhosis, abscess, carcinoma, amyloid and fatty degeneration.
